title: BLINDSPOT_CHECK.json - domain-expert blind-spot review (Phase B.2)
description: Produced by /auto-review-loop Phase B.2 per its SKILL.md. One check object per round; the docs say 'one per round, appended' while output-protocol.md fixes a single flat file - this schema validates the single latest-round object (known gap, see schemas/README.md). A fatal unresolved mode caps the round score at 5; severe caps at 6.

evidence_type.description: Evidence type from refine-logs/domain-signature.json that selected the failure-mode row.

failure_modes_checked.description: One entry per failure mode in the evidence_type row of domain-failure-modes.md.

mode.description: Failure-mode key from domain-failure-modes.md (e.g. endogeneity, boundary_condition_error).

evidence.description: file:line evidence (required for unresolved; may be 'missing').

severity.description: Catalog severity from domain-failure-modes.md (fatal caps score at 5, severe at 6).

fallback_reason.description: Present when domain-signature.json is missing and the derivational row is used as fallback (e.g. signature_missing).
